theorem le_index_sum {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {α : σ → ℝ} {r : σ → ℕ}
    (hs : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) {c : ℝ} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 → c ≤ index (f i) α r) :
    c ≤ index (∑ i ∈ s, f i) α r := by
  refine (le_index_iff hs).2 fun d hd ↦ ?_
  rw [map_sum, map_sum] at hd
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hid⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hd
  have hfi : f i ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hid (by rw [h0, map_zero, map_zero])
  exact (le_index_iff hfi).1 (hf i hi hfi) d hid

theorem index_eq_weightedOrder_div {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {r : σ → ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) (α : σ → ℝ) : index P α r =
      (((taylor α P : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ).weightedOrder fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j).toNat : ℝ) /
        ∏ i, r i := by
  set w : σ → ℕ := fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j
  set F : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ := ↑(taylor α P)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := MvPowerSeries.exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder w (f := F)
    ((MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite w).1 (by simpa [F] using hP))
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← hdw, ENat.toNat_natCast, ← weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div hr]
    exact index_le_weight (by simpa [F, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_taylor] using hd)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun e he ↦ ?_
    rw [weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div hr]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact_mod_cast ENat.toNat_le_toNat (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le w (f := F) (d := e)
      (by simpa [F, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_taylor] using he)) (by simp)

theorem index_unique [Unique σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α r =
      (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) : ℝ) / r default := by
  set q := Polynomial.taylor (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) with hqdef
  have key (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : eval α (hasseDeriv d P) = q.coeff (d default) := by
    rw [Polynomial.taylor_coeff, ← uniqueAlgEquiv_hasseDeriv, ← Finsupp.unique_single d]
    exact (eval₂_uniqueAlgEquiv (f := hasseDeriv d P) (φ := RingHom.id ℝ) (a := α)).symm
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hqdef, Ne, Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero, map_eq_zero_iff _ (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ).injective]
  rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [weight, hqdef] using index_le_weight (P := P) (α := α) (r := r)
      (d := Finsupp.single default q.natTrailingDegree)
      (by simpa [key] using Polynomial.trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.2 hq)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun d hd ↦ ?_
    simpa [weight, hqdef] using div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (by exact_mod_cast Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero (key d ▸ hd))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (r default))

end Roth

theorem le_index_of_forall_eval_eq_zero {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    {r : σ → ℕ} (hd : ∀ j, degreeOf j P ≤ r j) (α : σ → ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (hvan : ∀ d, (∀ j, d j ≤ r j) → weight r d < c → eval α (hasseDeriv d P) = 0) :
    c ≤ index P α r := by
  refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun d he ↦ le_of_not_gt fun hw ↦ he (hvan d (fun j ↦ ?_) hw)
  by_contra! hj
  exact he <| by rw [hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt ((hd j).trans_lt hj), map_zero]
